title: Mweya Wemwoyo Murefu
intro: Munhoroondo dzehuporofita, paiva nemweya une mwoyo murefu wakanyorwa muchimiro chavo. Nekuchema nenguva, vakabatirira patariro, vachiva muenzaniso usingaperi wekuvimba neuchenjeri hwaMwari. Unogona here kutsanangura chakavanzika chemunhu uyu asingazununguki?
clues: Ndakazvarirwa mumhuri yevaprofita, asi muedzo wangu mukuru wakauya kuburikidza nemwana wandaida zvikuru.
Ndakanyeverwa nezvegodo kubva kuhope dzakataurwa nemwanakomana wangu, uye ndakatya kuchengetedzeka kwake.
Maziso angu akacheneruka nekusuwa, asi handina kumbobvira ndarasikirwa nekutenda mutsitsi dzaAllah.
Kunhuhwirira kwemwana wangu akanga asipo kwakandisvika kure, uye ipapo ndakaziva kuti kusanganazve kwakanga kwava pedyo.
Mhuri yangu yakakotama ichionga apo chiono chekare chakazadzikiswa, uye maziso angu akadzorerwa.
Ndini ndakapihwa hembe ine ropa, asi gare gare ndakazopihwa hembe yakazondiporesa.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
